   303  /-- GCD monoid: a cancellative `CommMonoidWithZero` with `gcd` (greatest common divisor) and
   304  `lcm` (least common multiple) operations, determined up to a unit. The type class focuses on `gcd`
   305  and we derive the corresponding `lcm` facts from `gcd`.
   306  -/
   307  class GCDMonoid (α : Type*) [CommMonoidWithZero α] extends IsCancelMulZero α where
   308    /-- The greatest common divisor between two elements. -/
   309    gcd : α → α → α
   310    /-- The least common multiple between two elements. -/
   311    lcm : α → α → α
   312    /-- The GCD is a divisor of the first element. -/
   313    gcd_dvd_left : ∀ a b, gcd a b ∣ a
   314    /-- The GCD is a divisor of the second element. -/
   315    gcd_dvd_right : ∀ a b, gcd a b ∣ b
   316    /-- Any common divisor of both elements is a divisor of the GCD. -/
   317    dvd_gcd : ∀ {a b c}, a ∣ c → a ∣ b → a ∣ gcd c b
   318    /-- The product of two elements is `Associated` with the product of their GCD and LCM. -/

   320    /-- `0` is left-absorbing. -/
   321    lcm_zero_left : ∀ a, lcm 0 a = 0
   322    /-- `0` is right-absorbing. -/
   323    lcm_zero_right : ∀ a, lcm a 0 = 0
